question: When can production deploys happen?

expected_sources.evidence: on weekdays between 9:00 and 16:00

reference_answer: On weekdays between 9:00 and 16:00, never on Fridays after noon and never on public holidays.

question: Can I push a release to production on a Friday afternoon?

expected_sources.evidence: never on Fridays after noon

reference_answer: No. Production deploys never happen on Fridays after noon; outside the deploy windows a deploy needs approval from the incident commander on duty.

question: How many approvals does a pull request need?

expected_sources.evidence: one approving review and a green build

reference_answer: One approving review and a green build; changes to authentication, payments or data deletion need a second approval from the owning team.

question: Who needs to sign off on a change to the payment code?

expected_sources.evidence: Changes to authentication, payments or data deletion need a second approval

reference_answer: Besides the usual approving review, a second approval from a member of the owning team.

question: How big may a pull request be?

expected_sources.evidence: more than 400 lines are split

reference_answer: Small enough to review in under thirty minutes; pull requests that change more than 400 lines are split unless the reviewer agrees otherwise.

question: Error rates went up right after my release. What should I do?

expected_sources.evidence: roll back first and investigate afterwards

reference_answer: Roll back first and investigate afterwards; a rollback never needs approval.

question: How long does a rollback take?

expected_sources.evidence: takes about two minutes

reference_answer: About two minutes, to any of the last five releases.

question: How is a new release rolled out to users in production?

expected_sources.evidence: one percent of traffic, then twenty-five percent

reference_answer: After at least fifteen minutes on staging, it goes to one percent of traffic, then twenty-five percent, then all traffic.

question: When are feature flags removed?

expected_sources.evidence: removed within thirty days of reaching all users

reference_answer: Within thirty days of reaching all users.

question: How do I safely delete a column from a database table?

expected_sources.evidence: Removing a column therefore takes two releases

reference_answer: In two releases: stop using the column in the first, and drop it in the second, because old and new code run side by side during a rollout.

question: A test fails randomly in CI. Can I just re-run the build?

expected_sources.evidence: re-running a build until it passes is not a fix

reference_answer: No. The owning team fixes or quarantines a flaky test within two working days; re-running a build until it passes is not a fix.

question: How fast must the on-call engineer acknowledge a page?

expected_sources.evidence: acknowledges a page within 15 minutes

reference_answer: Within 15 minutes, at any time of day.

question: What happens if nobody answers a page?

expected_sources.evidence: it escalates to the secondary on-call engineer

reference_answer: It escalates to the secondary on-call engineer, and after another 15 minutes to the engineering manager.

question: When will a new hire start taking on-call shifts?

expected_sources.evidence: New team members join the rotation after their sixth week

reference_answer: After their sixth week, first shadowing an experienced engineer for one full rotation.

question: Do engineers get paid extra for being on call?

expected_sources.evidence: on-call allowance of 300 euros per week

reference_answer: Yes, an on-call allowance of 300 euros per week on top of their salary.

question: What counts as a SEV1 incident?

expected_sources.evidence: SEV1 means customers cannot use the product at all

reference_answer: Customers cannot use the product at all, or data is being lost.

question: How often do we post updates on the status page during a major outage?

expected_sources.evidence: updated within 30 minutes and then every hour

reference_answer: For a SEV1, within 30 minutes and then every hour until it is resolved; for a SEV2, within one hour.

question: When is a postmortem due after an incident?

expected_sources.evidence: written postmortem within five working days

reference_answer: Within five working days, for every SEV1 and SEV2 incident.

question: Does the incident commander fix the problem themselves?

expected_sources.evidence: they do not debug themselves

reference_answer: No. The incident commander coordinates the response and decides on rollbacks; they do not debug themselves.

question: How long do I have to submit an expense?

expected_sources.evidence: within 30 days of the purchase

reference_answer: Within 30 days of the purchase; older receipts need the manager's written approval.

question: Do I need permission before buying something for work that costs 400 euros?

expected_sources.evidence: Anything more expensive needs your manager's approval before you buy it

reference_answer: Yes. Anything over 150 euros needs the manager's approval before buying, recorded in the finance portal.

question: How much can a hotel cost per night in Paris?

expected_sources.evidence: up to 250 euros per night in London, Paris, Zurich and New York

reference_answer: Up to 250 euros per night.

question: How much money do I get for food on a business trip?

expected_sources.evidence: daily allowance of 45 euros for meals

reference_answer: A daily allowance of 45 euros for meals; meals with customers are reimbursed separately.

question: Should I take the train or fly to a city four hours away?

expected_sources.evidence: Trains are preferred over flights for journeys under five hours

reference_answer: Take the train: trains are preferred over flights for journeys under five hours.

question: How much can I spend on conferences, and how do I claim it?

expected_sources.evidence: learning budget of 1,500 euros per year
choose the category Learning

reference_answer: Up to 1,500 euros per year from the personal learning budget, claimed through the finance portal under the category Learning.

question: How many vacation days do employees get?

expected_sources.evidence: 28 vacation days per calendar year

reference_answer: 28 vacation days per calendar year, on top of public holidays.

question: Can I move unused holiday to next year?

expected_sources.evidence: Up to five unused days can be carried over

reference_answer: Up to five unused days, which must be taken by the end of March.

question: When do I need a doctor's certificate for being sick?

expected_sources.evidence: longer than three consecutive working days, upload a doctor's note

reference_answer: For an absence longer than three consecutive working days.

question: How much paid leave do I get when adopting a child?

expected_sources.evidence: including adoptive parents, receive 12 weeks

reference_answer: 12 weeks of fully paid leave, in up to three blocks within the first year after the adoption.

question: Can I take a sabbatical?

expected_sources.evidence: After five years at Larkspur Labs you can take an unpaid sabbatical

reference_answer: After five years, an unpaid sabbatical of up to three months, keeping the position and salary.

question: Can I work from Spain for a few weeks if my contract is in Germany?

expected_sources.evidence: Working from another country is possible for up to 30 days per year

reference_answer: Yes, for up to 30 days per year, after telling HR; longer stays need approval.

question: How much is the home office allowance?

expected_sources.evidence: one-time home office allowance of 1,000 euros

reference_answer: 1,000 euros once, renewed every three years, plus 40 euros a month for internet and electricity.

question: I live far from an office. Will the company pay for a coworking desk?

expected_sources.evidence: pays for a desk in a coworking space near you

reference_answer: Yes, if you live more than 50 kilometres from an office, up to 250 euros per month, booked through the office team.

question: When do I have to be available for meetings?

expected_sources.evidence: core hours of at least four hours a day

reference_answer: During the team's core hours, at least four hours a day, usually between 10:00 and 15:00.

question: Is a second monitor paid from my home office allowance?

expected_sources.evidence: does not count against the home office allowance

reference_answer: No. A monitor ordered from the equipment catalogue in the first month is paid by the company and does not count against the home office allowance.

question: When does my laptop arrive?

expected_sources.evidence: shipped to your home address five working days before you start

reference_answer: Five working days before the start date, at your home address.

question: How long does it take to get production access?

expected_sources.evidence: take up to three working days

reference_answer: Up to three working days, because it also needs approval from the security team.

question: What does an onboarding buddy do?

expected_sources.evidence: Your buddy is your first contact for questions

reference_answer: The buddy answers everyday questions, meets you twice in the first week and weekly for the following month, and helps ship your first change.

question: What do I need to get promoted?

expected_sources.evidence: work you have already done at the next level for at least six months

reference_answer: A promotion case, proposed by your manager, showing work already done at the next level for at least six months; a committee decides.

question: When do raises take effect?

expected_sources.evidence: take effect on the first of January

reference_answer: On the first of January, after the October review.

question: How long must passwords be?

expected_sources.evidence: at least 14 characters

reference_answer: At least 14 characters, unique for every account and stored in the company password manager.

question: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor login?

expected_sources.evidence: never text messages

reference_answer: No. Use the authenticator app or a hardware security key, never text messages.

question: I lost my work laptop on the train. What do I do?

expected_sources.evidence: Report a lost or stolen laptop or phone to the security team within one hour

reference_answer: Report it to the security team within one hour through the security hotline; the device is wiped remotely.

question: What should I do with a suspicious email?

expected_sources.evidence: report button in your email client

reference_answer: Report it with the report button in your email client rather than forwarding it.

question: May I paste customer data into an AI chat tool?

expected_sources.evidence: never pasted into external tools

reference_answer: No. Confidential data, including all customer data, is never pasted into external tools that the security team has not approved.

question: Which security settings must a work laptop have, and is it set up that way when it arrives?

expected_sources.evidence: the screen must lock after five minutes
disk encryption already switched on

reference_answer: Disk encryption, a screen lock after five minutes and updates within seven days; new laptops arrive with disk encryption already switched on.
